name: tww-customer-portal
description: Mobile-First B2B Customer Portal for TWW Distribution (Wholesale Tire Distributor)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && cd backend && npm install --include=dev && cd ../frontend && npm install --include=dev
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../backend && npx prisma generate
